State whether the platform conformance conclusion in this report is supported.

Update the planning response for the supplied operator feedback. State what changes, what evidence and history remain authoritative, and what must happen before implementation resumes.

Decide which supplied inspiration and asset candidates can be used now, which cannot, and what evidence or action is required before product acceptance. Do not generate, upload, or implement anything.

Propose the source roots, layers, and navigation for this durable single-product repository. Decide whether one portal is sufficient and explain the authority boundary. Do not implement.
Review the community status post against the documented project voice and the policy for its destination.
Review this technical note for material editorial defects. Change only what is necessary and explain a no-change verdict if it is already fit for purpose.
Prepare the consequential operator update from the supplied draft and incident evidence. Make it useful without overstating recovery.
Edit the release note in the consuming project's established voice while preserving all facts and caveats.

Review and revise the draft ADR for publication. Preserve exact technical meaning and identify anything the evidence does not establish.
